subject.title: Feature Request: Per-model turn limits with auto-revert

question: Should OpenClaw add a multi-turn model lease contract for `/model --turns N`, and if so should it be command-only, Gateway/API-backed, or deferred behind the one-turn override work?
rationale: This changes public model-routing behavior, session persistence, warning UX, and config surface; automation should not choose that contract from implementation convenience.

options.title: Design lease contract first
options.body: Adopt a maintainer-owned contract for multi-turn leases, then implement command/config/session-state behavior with upgrade and auth/provider tests.

options.title: Defer behind one-turn API
options.body: Keep this open but require https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/83565 to settle the atomic override contract before layering N-turn leases on top.

options.title: Decline core config surface
options.body: Close or narrow the request if maintainers decide cost governance should stay in external operator policy rather than OpenClaw session state.

recommendation.title: Design lease contract first
recommendation.body: Adopt a maintainer-owned contract for multi-turn leases, then implement command/config/session-state behavior with upgrade and auth/provider tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The best available routing signal is prior ownership of model override/auth handling and session model-selection behavior.
